diagrams.title: **The model never runs code
diagrams.caption: **The model never runs code.** Step 2 is only a *request*. LangChain runs the function and stores the result as a **ToolMessage**; then the model reads it and decides what to do next.
diagrams.svg:
<svg class="dimmable" viewBox="0 0 1100 380" aria-label="The agent loop. 1: your question goes to the LLM. 2: the LLM replies with a tool call. 3: LangChain runs the search tool and sends a ToolMessage back to the LLM; steps 2 and 3 may repeat. 4: when there are no more tool calls, the LLM writes the final answer." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker><marker id="ah-brain" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-brain" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker><marker id="ah-tool" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-tool" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker></defs>
      <rect x="20" y="40" width="200" height="110" rx="14" class="usr" style="fill:#E8EAF1;stroke:#4A5170;stroke-width:2.5"></rect>

      <text x="480" y="116" text-anchor="middle" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">answer, or ask for a tool?</text>
      <rect x="800" y="40" width="280" height="110" rx="14" class="tool" style="fill:#D6F2EE;stroke:#0B7F73;stroke-width:2.5"></rect>

      </g>

diagrams.title: **LangChain picks the strategy for you
diagrams.caption: **LangChain picks the strategy for you.** **ProviderStrategy** is used for providers with native structured output (OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI and others). **ToolStrategy** works with any tool-calling model. Force one with `ToolStrategy(AgentAnswer)` or `ProviderStrategy(AgentAnswer)` from `langchain.agents.structured_output`.
